column1: # Source-owned test-evidence fragment for parser function AST restore.

column8: All 54 function-call restore vectors execute with exact Go canonical output, including interval, trim, sequence, weight-string, and charset-introducer forms.
All five CAST/CONVERT/BINARY restore vectors execute with exact Go canonical output and charset/type spelling.
All 26 aggregate restore vectors execute with exact Go canonical output, including COUNT(*) to COUNT(1), aliases, DISTINCT, and GROUP_CONCAT ordering/separators.
All four valid charset canonicalization rows and both invalid unknown/compound charset rows execute; Rust exposes structured ParseError rather than Go's numeric [parser:1115] error wrapper.
